bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-live-2467fe6"
session="$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
sock="$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 2467fe6847f5ef9f42ff74ff595cfb23401d678d || exit 75
test -f "$w/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 76
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 82
test "$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value)" = yes || exit 83
test -f "$session" && test ! -L "$session" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 84
pid=$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)
test -n "$pid" && test "$pid" != 0 || exit 85
if test ! -S "$sock"; then
 echo RESIDENT_IPC_SOCKET_MISSING
 echo USERBOT_TEST_BLOCKED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
else
 echo RESIDENT_IPC_SOCKET_PRESENT
 test "$(stat -c %a "$sock")" = 600 || exit 86
 test "$(stat -c %u "$sock")" = "$(id -u)" || exit 87
 python3 -B - "$r" "$w" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
worktree=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path.insert(0,str(worktree/"scripts"))
import userbot_resident_ipc as ipc
import userbot_test_client as client
socket_path=root/"deploy"/"secrets"/"userbot_verify.sock"
ipc.SOCKET_PATH=socket_path
client.SOCKET_PATH=socket_path
for action in ("health","bot_start_menu"):
    sys.argv=["userbot_test_client.py",action]
    if client.main()!=0:
        print("USERBOT_ALLOWED_IPC_ACTION_FAILED="+action)
        sys.exit(88)
print("USERBOT_ALLOWED_IPC_ACTIONS_PASS")
PY
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 90
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 91
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$pid" || exit 92
test -f "$session" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 93
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_POSTCHECK_PASS
